title: BigDataClaw Database Rebuild & Recruiter Fix - 2026-04-02
content:
# BigDataClaw Database Rebuild & Recruiter Fix - 2026-04-02

**Session ID:** session_2026-04-02_17:13:26
**Timestamp:** 2026-04-02T17:13:26.547041

## Work Completed

### 1. Recruiter Database Rebuild ✅
Rebuilt entire recruiter database from DBeaver exports with actual cities/regions

**Stats:**
- Total Agents: 96,265 (up from 28,505)
- Unique Cities: 93
- Unique Brokerages: 2978
- Top City: Toronto (37,624)

**Features:**
- Joined realtor_brokers + realtor_salespersons with realtor_brokerages
- Real city data: 93 unique cities across Ontario
- Proper quick links generated for all 96,265 agents
- SQLite FTS5 search fixed for special characters (St. Catharines)
- JSON bloat reduced from 395MB to 77MB
- Frontend switched to EXAgentRecruiterUpdated component
- Vercel deployment config fixed to build nerve/ directory

### 2. Frontend Routing Fix ✅
Fixed EXP Agent Recruiter not displaying and city filter returning 0 results

**Fixes:**
- App.jsx now routes to EXAgentRecruiterUpdated instead of old component
- City dropdown searches across all agent fields instead of exact city match
- JSON fallback when API server is offline
- Added 500/page pagination option
- Vercel builds from nerve/ directory with correct output path

### 3. API Search Fix ✅
Fixed SQLite FTS5 search breaking on special characters in city names

Fix: FTS5 queries now wrapped in double quotes to escape periods and special chars

## Pattern for Other Data Types

Same DBeaver join → SQLite → JSON → Frontend pattern applies to all data types

**Applies to:**
- Builders (companys_final.csv + company_contacts_final.csv)
- Buyers (sale_agents_final.csv)
- Sellers (sale_agents_final.csv)
- Commercial Realtors (realtor_brokers_final.csv filtered by job_title)
- Brokers (realtor_brokers_final.csv)
- Companies (companys_final.csv)
- Lenders (lenders_final.csv + lender_contacts_final.csv)

**Steps:**
- 1. Identify the DBeaver CSV files for the entity type
- 2. Join parent/child tables on foreign keys (e.g., broker_id)
- 3. Generate quick links for each record
- 4. Create/update SQLite table with proper indexes and FTS5
- 5. Export lean JSON to nerve/public/data/ for frontend fallback
- 6. Update/create frontend view component
- 7. Add API endpoints in api_server.py
- 8. Wire up routing in nerve/src/App.jsx

## Quick Commands

```bash
# Rebuild recruiters
python3 rebuild_recruiters_from_dbeaver.py

# Start API server
python3 api_server.py

# Check agent count
sqlite3 bigdataclaw.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruiters;'

# Check city distribution
sqlite3 bigdataclaw.db 'SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM recruiters GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20;'

# Build frontend
cd nerve && npm run build
```

## URLs
- nerve_dashboard: http://localhost:5173
- exp_recruiter: http://localhost:5173/exp-agent-recruiter
- api_base: http://localhost:8000/api
- api_health: http://localhost:8000/api/health
- vercel_deploy: https://bigdataclaw-6ks8i50gg-ish0075s-projects.vercel.app

## Next Steps
- [ ] Restart api_server.py to serve the new 96K recruiter database
- [ ] Redeploy frontend to Vercel with updated vercel.json
- [ ] Test city filters: Toronto (~37K), Mississauga (~10K), Markham (~9K)
- [ ] Apply same rebuild pattern to Builders directory
- [ ] Apply same rebuild pattern to Lenders matcher
- [ ] Apply same rebuild pattern to Buyer/Seller agents
- [ ] Add company data to Company search/matcher

title: Obsidian Integration V2 - READ ONLY Architecture
content: Fixed architecture to be READ ONLY. NERVE/BigDataClaw only reads/listens to BDAIV2 - NO WRITE OPERATIONS. Created obsidian_api.py with read-only ObsidianReader class that blocks all write operations (PUT/POST/DELETE). Removed all write endpoints, removed session logging to BDAIV2 (now ContextKeep only), renamed session exporter to save_session_to_contextkeep.py (BDAIV2 removed). Tested successfully - write operations blocked with PermissionError, read operations work (259 files accessible).

content: Confirmed main working vault path: /home/jamie/Desktop/Jamie's Personal Vault (NOT BDAIV2). Updated obsidian_api.py VAULT_PATH configuration. Vault contains key folders: Agents, Builders, Commercial Realtors, Land_Lenders, Lenders, and files like NERVE_BIGDATACLAW_SETUP.md, 281 Chippawa Rd Port Colborne Buyers Report.md.

title: CORRECTED Architecture - Main Vault Write, BDAIV2 Read-Only
content: Fixed architecture: Main Working Vault (/home/jamie/Desktop/Jamie's Personal Vault) is READ + WRITE - all sessions, agent workspaces, and files are written here. BDAIV2 is READ ONLY - never written to. Created ObsidianVaultClient with read_only flag. Main vault client accepts writes, BDAIV2 client blocks all writes with PermissionError. Session exporter updated to write to Main Vault Session_Logs/ folder via API.

# Database Data Integrity Fix - Complete

**Session ID:** session_2026-04-03-data-integrity-fix
**Timestamp:** 2026-04-03T21:50:00
**Classification:** CRITICAL UPDATE - All Agents

## Problem Identified
Database was missing 85% of buyer/seller entities and 78% of lenders:
- Buyers table: 5,130 records but transactions referenced 15,925 unique buyers
- Sellers table: Didn't exist (0 records) but transactions had 19,224 unique sellers  
- Lenders table: 1,131 records but DBeaver export had 5,113 lenders

## Solution Implemented
1. **Imported 34,852 companies** from DBeaver companys_final.csv
2. **Populated buyers table**: 5,130 → 18,496 records (+261%)
3. **Created sellers table**: 0 → 19,223 records (NEW)
4. **Updated lenders table**: 1,131 → 5,113 records (+352%)
5. **Categorized all lenders** by type and specialization
